description: A single contact in the principal's local address book. Carries the contact's DID, a display name (used for UI surfaces + filesystem alias slug), optional relay endpoint for `did:key` peers (`did:web` peers discover their relay live via their DID document's serviceEndpoint), and optional first-added timestamp. The contact book lives on disk as `<self_root>/contacts.md` — a single markdown file with one `## <display_name>` section per contact, YAML frontmatter under each header carrying the typed fields, and free-form markdown prose between sections that the agent reads as additional principal-authored context about the contact. Private per principal — never sent on wire, never shared with other roster members.

did.description: The contact's canonical decentralized identifier — `did:web:<host>` for domain-anchored peers, `did:key:z<multibase>` for self-contained identities.

display_name.description: Informal name for UI surfaces. Validates against the `DisplayName` value object (non-empty, length-bounded, no control characters). Drives the on-disk alias for this contact's queue tree via `DisplayName::slug()` (lowercased, kebabified).

full_name.description: Optional formal name for envelope addressing / signature display contexts.

relay_endpoint.description: Optional WebSocket / HTTPS endpoint where this contact's relay accepts envelopes addressed to their DID. Required for `did:key` peers (whose relay must be exchanged out-of-band on first contact); omitted for `did:web` peers (whose DID document carries the canonical `serviceEndpoint`, looked up live). Same format as `tech.equanimi.secretariat.orgDoc.serviceEndpoint`.

added_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when this contact was first added to the book. Decorative — never affects routing or trust.
